notes: The byline 'Darth Vader "The Dark" Lord of The Sith' is a prank name; the deck is credited to the DeckTech handle The Dark as plain text (no player page), as with decks 18424, 18479 and 18637.

No objective. Starting cards as posted with '- STARTING': You Cannot Hide Forever, I Will Find Them Quickly, Master, His Name Is Anakin (the three Effects Prepared Defenses deploys) and Prepared Defenses; these count toward the 60. No starting location is marked.
Format Premiere - Coruscant: the list uses Coruscant-set cards (Darth Maul, Young Apprentice, Destroyer Droid, Maul Strikes).
'Weapons and Devices (7)' is a section header, not a card, and was removed; the deck totals 60 as published.
Posted 'Graga' dested the Dark Tatooine character Gragra.
Posted 'Tatooine Jabba's Palace Lower Chamber's' matches no card; it dested Jabba's Palace: Lower Passages, the only Dark Jabba's Palace site with 'Lower' in its name (as in deck 18424).

Posted Tatooine Jabba's Palace Audience Chamber, Entrance Cavern, Mos Eisley, Cantina and Docking Bay 94 dested the Dark site printings; 'Tatooine Jabba's Palace' dested the Dark Jabba's Palace site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'Coruscant Docking Bay' dested the Dark Special Edition Coruscant: Docking Bay, as in deck 18424.
Posted 'Vader's Lightsaber' and 'Darth Vader's Lightsaber' are two different cards (Premiere and Death Star II) and are kept as both.

Same author's later 'Seek Out And Destroy The Jedis' (deck 18424, 18 August 2001) is a close variant (adds Sith Probe Droid and No Escape; drops Gragra, 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle and Kir Kanos); the lists differ, so this is a separate page.
The strategy says the author won seven of seven games with the deck; no event is named.
